qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant global sleep apnea toll booth (~70% global share, >90% US share post-Philips recall) protected by AirView (>28M connected devices) and Brightree SaaS deeply embedded in HME clinical and billing workflows. Razor-and-blade model locks in high-margin recurring mask and accessory resupply. 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 22.9% (27.4% in FY25) and gross margins expanding to 59.4% prove formidable pricing power well above medical inflation.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Undisputed global leader in sleep-disordered breathing with ~70% global share and razor-and-blade consumable resupply lock-in. Real-world 2025-2026 data shows GLP-1 therapies act as a diagnostic funnel (+11% CPAP initiation) rather than a replacement, with sleep medicine adopting multimodal standards. Balance sheet fortress with >$1.07B net cash and 88.8% FCF conversion. [5-10Y g: patient diagnosis & device/mask volume 5.5% + price/product mix 1.5% + software/reinvestment 0.5% - competitive/freight drag 0.5% + net share repurchases 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 22.91% expanding to 27.39% in FY2025 ($1.89B EBIT on $5.65B revenue); tangible ROIC of 50-74%. GAAP gross margins expanded 270 bps to 59.4% (60.0% non-GAAP). Multi-year Owner FCF conversion of 88.8% ($1.55B Owner FCF vs $156M capex in FY25). Pristine balance sheet with $1.47B cash against $399M LT debt (net cash $1.07B; zero net interest expense). 9-year Owner EPS CAGR of 18.1% ($2.75 in FY16 to $10.74 in FY25) with zero cycle dips. Real-world IQVIA/claims studies of >2.5M patients confirm GLP-1 users have 10.8 percentage point higher CPAP initiation and superior resupply adherence, invalidating terminal obsolescence thesis.
